requirements.quantity: Complete positive link resistance, stud solder to stud solder including both contacts
requirements.method: Reversing four-wire DC; isolate parallel paths; measure both finished assemblies at relevant operating and temperature corners after conditioning

requirements.quantity: Copper grade, conductivity, dimensions and net normal section
requirements.basis: Project construction and calculation assumptions, not material certificate
requirements.method: Actual C11000 temper certificate/conductivity traceability, CMM/bore/thickness metrology including machined risers and all internal radii; coating thickness cross-section/XRF; renew BREP analysis from as-built dimensions

requirements.quantity: Stud heights, matched bar planes, fastener engagement and tip clearance
requirements.method: Actual Würth drawing plus received-height/stencil/seating process review; gauge through thread and actual screw/washer length bounds, NPTH tip clearance and terminal bearing; torque with temporary holding fixture that keeps wrench load off SMT studs and thin support

requirements.quantity: Tape thickness/coverage, corner radius, cap fit, dielectric and abrasion
requirements.method: Specify actual working/fault voltage and environment; qualify wrapping, deburring/radius, seams, contact masks, cap capture, fastener isolation and aging; inspect every received wrap and matched cavity against envelope

requirements.quantity: Bond, cantilever, PEEK thread and fault retention strength
requirements.method: Identify actual retained-floor polymer/printing direction; prepare actual PEEK/floor coupons and DP460EG bondline/cure process. Test pull/shear/peel, vibration/drop/temperature creep and complete fault retention. Do not substitute generic datasheet lap shear or PEEK tensile strength for the actual joint
requirements.native_support_scope: Nominal fit plus declared max-thickness/wrap endpoint envelopes, not a proof of all continuous matched support machining/receiving combinations. Regenerate and collision-check the actual measured configuration before acceptance.

requirements.method: Use measured assembled board planes, actual carrier/base/PCB CTE and service temperature range. Validate the integral dogleg's3D compliance and PEEK saddle sliding/abrasion. Thermal cycle fully assembled joints, measure resistance/temperature/loosening and inspect SMT solder. Never equate a fully restrained straight-bar stress estimate to actual dogleg force

Assemble both-face parts, all mated headers/control wiring, washer/head tolerances, wrap seams and caps. Gauge switch tails/solder and press every control through travel; repeat across measured board-height and tolerance extremes. A CAD screen is not a physical fit pass

requirements.quantity: Current, hot contact temperature, faults and noise
requirements.method: Close actual simultaneous-current ledger and component/material temperature limits, measure thermal rise and joint resistance at operating/fault corners, qualify fusing/health gating, EMC/audio/noise and inductive coupling. DC resistance alone does not establish RF or audio performance
